title: mcbench scenario
description: A reproducible benchmark scenario. A scenario is a recipe, never a world save: it declares a seed and a scripted setup sequence from which the world is generated deterministically on the operator's machine. See docs/LICENSING.md (worlds may not be redistributed) and docs/METHODOLOGY.md section 7.

id.description: Stable identifier, kebab-case. Never reused for different content.

version.description: Semantic version. Any change that could move the numbers is a MAJOR bump; results are never pooled across a major bump (METHODOLOGY.md section 7).

side.description: Which side is measured. 'both' runs an integrated client+server instance.

minecraft_versions.description: Game versions this scenario is valid for. Empty means unrestricted.

requires.description: Runtime capabilities the scenario needs. 'carpet' enables tick-warp driving.

seed.description: Fixed world seed. Identical across every variant in a comparison.

time.description: Fixed world time in ticks; prevents day/night from varying the load.

force_fresh.description: Generate this scenario's terrain on every run instead of reusing one generated world. Only for scenarios that measure generation itself; the fingerprint then differs every run by construction and stops gating pooling.

fingerprint_region.description: Region hashed to produce the world fingerprint. Runs with differing fingerprints are never pooled, unless the scenario sets force_fresh.

setup.description: Deterministic world preparation, executed untimed before warmup.

workload.description: The scripted load driven during warmup and measurement. Must be deterministic and loopable.

min.description: Minimum warmup in seconds (client) or ticks (server).

max_multiple.description: Hard ceiling as a multiple of min. Exceeding it flags warmup_not_converged.

duration.description: Measurement window in seconds (client) or ticks (server).

primary_metric.description: The metric this scenario is designed to resolve. Must exist in the metric registry.

metrics.description: Additional metrics to report. Empty means the side's full default set.

tick_warp.description: Drive the server with Carpet tick warp, removing the 20 TPS clamp so headroom becomes measurable.

saturated.description: Scenario deliberately exceeds the tick budget. Only then is tps_effective meaningful.
